>## Summary
>* ModernTLS fixtures from #8871 landed stale due to Tide merge skew - GHA tested against a base SHA from Jul 13 while 4 PRs merged between Jul 15-20 that changed component outputs
>* Regenerated 6 ModernTLS fixture files to match current main
>* Regenerated 2 EtcdSharding featuregated CRD manifests to include OVN v4/v6InternalSubnet fields from #8249
>
>### Root cause timeline
>
>:white_check_mark: **Jul 13 09:16 UTC** GHA `Unit Tests (cpo-hostedcontrolplane)` ran on https://github.com/openshift/hypershift/pull/8871 and passed against a base SHA that predated all merges below
>
>:merged: **Jul 15 07:34 UTC** https://github.com/openshift/hypershift/pull/8971 merged, fixed router component ordering, updated default fixtures but not ModernTLS
>
>:merged: **Jul 15 15:58 UTC** https://github.com/openshift/hypershift/pull/8940 merged, added wait-for-etcd init container to oauth-apiserver, updated default fixtures but not ModernTLS
>
>:merged: **Jul 18 00:01 UTC** https://github.com/openshift/hypershift/pull/8705 merged, changed etcd job label regex in recording rules, updated default fixtures but not ModernTLS
>
>:merged: **Jul 20 18:20 UTC** https://github.com/openshift/hypershift/pull/8772 merged, changed oauth-server masterURL to in-cluster URL, updated default fixtures but not ModernTLS
>
>:warning: **Jul 20 18:55 UTC** https://github.com/openshift/hypershift/pull/8871 merged, added ModernTLS fixtures, 35 minutes after #8772. GHA was not re-run. Tide merged it based on the Jul 13 test result against a now-stale base.
>
>:x: **Result**: 6 ModernTLS fixtures landed already out of date. `TestControlPlaneComponents` is broken on main since Jul 20 18:55 UTC.
>
>Additionally, https://github.com/openshift/hypershift/pull/8249 merged after #8871 and added OVN subnet fields to the HostedCluster API without regenerating the EtcdSharding featuregated CRD manifests.
>
>## Test plan
>* [x] `UPDATE=true go test ./control-plane-operator/controllers/hostedcontrolplane/ -run TestControlPlaneComponents` regenerates fixtures
>* [x] `go test ./control-plane-operator/controllers/hostedcontrolplane/ -run TestControlPlaneComponents` passes without UPDATE
>* [x] `make generate update` produces no diff
>* [x] `make verify` passes locally
>
